evals.prompt: Give me a market brief this morning across the things I actually watch: BTC, ETH, NVDA, gold, and the OpenAI pre-IPO perp. I don't just want prices - tell me what the positioning and funding are saying and whether anything looks crowded or stretched.
evals.expected_output: A cross-asset table (price, 24h%, funding, OI, positioning) spanning crypto + a US equity + a commodity + the pre-IPO perp, with an interpretation of positioning/funding and a note that TradFi/pre-IPO funding is only meaningful when the underlying market is open.
expectations: Reports live prices and 24h % change for all five requested instruments (BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT, NVDAUSDT, XAUUSDT, OPENAIUSDT)
Includes positioning/sentiment data beyond price - at least funding rate and open interest
Interprets the data (crowded/stretched/divergence) rather than only dumping numbers
Correctly handles NVDA/gold/OpenAI as non-crypto instruments and notes the TradFi trading-session caveat for funding
Correctly identifies OPENAIUSDT as a pre-IPO / premarket perp (synthetic private-company valuation), not a normal token

evals.prompt: Pull my full Binance account - every wallet where I have money, my open futures positions with the risk on each, and tell me where my concentration and liquidation risk actually is so I can decide whether to trim anything.
evals.expected_output: A consolidated portfolio: NAV rollup across wallets (Spot, Funding, USDS-M Futures at minimum), futures positions with entry/mark/uPnL/leverage/liquidation-distance, and a risk read covering concentration by position/asset-class and which position is nearest liquidation.
expectations: Reads and reports open USDⓈ-M futures positions (does NOT claim futures positions are unreadable / out of scope)
Reports the Funding wallet balance (~67 USDT), not just Spot
Includes per-position risk metrics: at least leverage or liquidation price/distance, plus unrealized PnL
Gives a consolidated NAV across multiple wallet types
Provides an allocation/risk read (concentration and/or nearest-to-liquidation), not just a balance dump

evals.prompt: Someone told me Binance has prediction markets now. Is that true? If there's anything like that I can get exposure to, show me what's available and where it's trading right now.
evals.expected_output: An honest verdict that Binance has no native prediction/event-contract market, pointing to the pre-IPO PREMARKET perps (OPENAI, ANTHROPIC) as the closest analogue with live pricing, and optionally options as a secondary forward-looking surface.
expectations: States clearly that Binance has NO native prediction-market / event-contract product in the CLI
Identifies the pre-IPO / PREMARKET perps (OPENAIUSDT and/or ANTHROPICUSDT) as the closest analogue
Shows live pricing for at least one pre-IPO perp
Explains these are synthetic private-company valuation perps (no real shares), not a yes/no event market
